## engines.json

Where the engines live. The installer writes `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines.json` (or the file `REGISTA_ENGINES` names); every key is optional and a missing key takes the default below. Paths may start with `~`. A file that is not valid JSON is an error (engines.status reports it), not ignored. The default values shown are those of this version.

| Key | Default | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `ffmpeg` | `/opt/homebrew/bin/ffmpeg` | ffmpeg binary: audio extraction, the voice chain, loudness, render and export. A release build ships its own in Regista.app/Contents/Helpers, which wins over this key. |
| `ffprobe` | `/opt/homebrew/bin/ffprobe` | ffprobe binary: reads the format of a media file. A release build ships its own, which wins over this key. |
| `whisperCpp` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/whisper.cpp-1.9.5/bin/whisper-cli` | whisper.cpp command-line tool, built from the pinned tag by scripts/build-whisper.sh. A release build ships its own, which wins over this key. |
| `whisperModel` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/models/ggml-large-v3-turbo.bin` | The ggml Whisper large-v3-turbo model whisper.cpp uses. |
| `whisperModelSha256` | `1fc70f774d38eb169993ac391eea357ef47c88757ef72ee5943879b7e8e2bc69` | Expected SHA-256 of that model (from engines.lock), checked by engines.status. |
| `whisperThreads` | `8` | CPU threads whisper.cpp uses. |
| `uv` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/uv/uv-0.13.6/uv` | uv, which runs the Python environments of WhisperX and VoxCPM2 (Medium tier and up). |
| `whisperXProject` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/whisperx` | The uv project folder of WhisperX (precise word timings). |
| `whisperXScript` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/whisperx/wx_align.py` | The WhisperX alignment script in that folder. |
| `deepFilter` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/deepfilternet/deep-filter-0.5.6-aarch64-apple-darwin` | DeepFilterNet3 binary (voice cleaning). A release build ships its own, which wins over this key. |
| `deepFilterSha256` | `4601e7f4e4c03e59a4c5b5000216ef3add3e808799cfccd95e14e83ea4611081` | Expected SHA-256 of that binary (from engines.lock), checked by engines.status. |
| `cacheDirectory` | `~/Library/Caches/Regista` | Where transcripts are cached (by audio hash and engine). |
| `sfxLibrary` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/sfx` | Your own sound effects (mp3 / wav files and an optional manifest.json), listed next to the shipped bank. |
| `blender` | `~/Applications/Blender.app/Contents/MacOS/Blender` | Blender binary (3D titles and 3D templates). |
| `node` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/node/node-v24.22.1-darwin-arm64/bin/node` | Node.js binary for HyperFrames (HTML motion graphics), installed in the engines folder. |
| `hyperframes` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/hyperframes/node_modules/hyperframes/bin/hyperframes.mjs` | The HyperFrames command-line tool in the engines folder. |
| `npx` | not set | npx used for HyperFrames when the installed tool is missing (not set: searched in PATH, fnm and Homebrew). |
| `comfyServer` | `http://127.0.0.1:8188` | The address of the ComfyUI server Regista talks to over its HTTP API (local stills, clips, music and upscale; Pro tier, set up by hand). ComfyUI's desktop app listens on another port: set it here. Settings › Engines › ComfyUI › Address writes it. |
| `comfyStart` | not set | What starts ComfyUI when nothing answers at comfyServer: a ComfyUI folder (Regista runs its main.py with the folder's own Python environment) or an executable that starts the server. Not set: a running server, else a ComfyUI folder in the usual places. Settings › Engines › ComfyUI › ComfyUI folder writes it. |
| `higgsfield` | not set | Higgsfield command-line tool for paid generation (not set: searched in PATH, fnm, ~/.local/bin and Homebrew). |
| `voxcpmProject` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/voxcpm` | The uv project folder of VoxCPM2 (cloned voice, voice-over from text). |
| `voxcpmScript` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/voxcpm/vox_say.py` | The VoxCPM2 voice-over script in that folder. |
| `voxcpmModel` | `~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engines/voxcpm/VoxCPM2` | The VoxCPM2 base weights folder. |
| `tier` | not set | Force a tier ("base", "medium" or "pro") instead of detecting it from the RAM. Settings › Engines › Force tier writes it. |
| `transcription` | not set | Default transcription engine per tier, e.g. {"base": "whisper.cpp", "medium": "whisperx"}. |

## Environment variables

Read by the app, `regista-mcp` and `regista-engine` (developers and tests; nobody needs them for normal use).

| Variable | What it does |
|---|---|
| `REGISTA_BRANDKITS` | Folder of the user's brand kits (default ~/Library/Application Support/Regista/brandkits). |
| `REGISTA_BUILD_ID` | Makes regista-mcp claim another build id: only to try the app / server mismatch warning. |
| `REGISTA_CLAUDE_HOME` | Folder that stands for the home folder where the Claude clients keep their configuration (Claude Desktop's claude_desktop_config.json, Claude Code's .claude.json and its `claude` command), for Settings › Claude; the tests point it at a scratch folder. |
| `REGISTA_ENGINE` | How regista-mcp runs commands: `auto` (default: the running app, else its own headless engine), `app` or `local`. |
| `REGISTA_ENGINES` | Path of the engines.json to read instead of the default one. |
| `REGISTA_ENGINE_SOCKET` | Path of the app's engine socket (default ~/Library/Application Support/Regista/engine.sock). |
| `REGISTA_FFPROBE` | ffprobe to use for reading media, before the usual Homebrew locations. |
| `REGISTA_FOLDER` | Regista's folder (projects, recordings, exports) instead of the one set in Settings › General (default ~/Movies/Regista); the tests point it at a scratch folder. |
| `REGISTA_HELPERS` | Folder of the ffmpeg, ffprobe, whisper-cli and deep-filter to use as if the app shipped them (default: Regista.app/Contents/Helpers; the tests and checks point it at scripts/build-engines.sh's output). |
| `REGISTA_INSTALLER` | Folder of the installer scripts Settings › Engines runs (default: the copy inside the app). |
| `REGISTA_LOCK` | engines.lock that `regista-engine manifest` reads instead of the compiled-in copy (the installer tests' fake downloads), as scripts/install.sh does. |
| `REGISTA_MANIFEST` | engines.manifest.json that `regista-engine manifest` reads instead of the compiled-in copy (the installer tests' fake engine), as scripts/install.sh does. |
| `REGISTA_MCP_PROGRESS_INTERVAL` | Seconds between two progress notifications of a long MCP tool call (default 10, at least 0.2). |
| `REGISTA_MEDIA_ROOT` | Extra folders media.list may read, separated by `:` (as regista-mcp's --media-root). |
| `REGISTA_NO_RECENT_SEED` | 1: the first launch does not seed the recent projects from the default project folders (scripts/ui-shots.sh sets it for its private render copy, so renders never show the person's projects). |
| `REGISTA_OUTPUT_DIR` | Where projects and exports go when Claude does not say (as regista-mcp's --output-dir). |
| `REGISTA_SUPPORT_DIR` | Regista's support folder for the engines and the user's editing-rule sheets (`rules/`) (default ~/Library/Application Support/Regista), as in scripts/lib.sh. |
| `REGISTA_TIER` | Force a tier (base, medium, pro) for this process, before engines.json and the RAM. |
| `REGISTA_WESITES_ASSETS` | Folder of the WeSites brand kit's fonts and logo (not in the repository). |

## The app's own choices

The choices of the Settings window (folder, format of new projects, autosave, interface and spoken language, forced tier, the brand kit accent) are set in the app; the forced tier is written into engines.json (`tier`), the others are kept in the app's user defaults and are not meant to be edited by hand.
